cards.text: The LORD is speaking through Hosea, His prophet, and He's been describing His people as an unfaithful wife who went after her lovers, burned incense to the Baals and forgot Him (Hosea 2:2-13). Then He says, "Therefore, behold…" and friend, I'm bracing myself.

cards.question: Right after all that hard talk about His unfaithful people, the LORD says, "Therefore, behold…" and keeps going. What does He say He'll do with her?

answers.text: Allure her and speak to her tenderly
Leave her to wander on her own
Hand her back over to her lovers

cards.text: After ALL that, the LORD says He'll lead her to the wilderness and speak to her TENDERLY. Friend, back when I was stuck in a junk drawer, the most tender words I ever heard came from the dead batteries next to me, and those words were "Scoot over."

cards.question: Earlier, the LORD said He'd take back His grain and His new wine (Hosea 2:9). Now, in the wilderness, He says He will give back her ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD names a place: the Valley of Achor. That's where Achan, the man who brought trouble on Israel, was stoned (Joshua 7:24-26).

cards.question: The LORD says He'll take the Valley of Achor, that place tied to trouble, and make it into a gateway of ___.
True or false: The LORD says that in the wilderness, His people will respond as they did in the day they came up out of Egypt.

cards.text: Then the LORD declares what's coming in that day. She's going to call Him by a different name.

cards.question: True or false: In that day, the LORD's people will call Him "my Master" and no longer call Him "my Husband."
The LORD says He'll remove something from the lips of His people, so it's never invoked again. What is it?

answers.text: The songs of their old feasts

cards.text: Now the LORD says that on that day, He'll make a covenant for His people. And wait till you hear who's on the other side of it.

cards.question: On that day, who does the LORD say He'll make a covenant with for His people?

answers.text: The beasts and birds and crawling creatures
The kings of the nations around them
The priests who served the Baals

cards.question: Then the LORD talks about the land itself. What does He say He'll abolish there?
True or false: Along with abolishing battle in the land, the LORD says He'll make His people lie down in safety.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks right to her: "So I will betroth you to Me…" Friend, after everything we heard about her lovers and the Baals, I did NOT see that coming.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says He'll betroth His people to Himself for a season.

cards.text: And He says He'll betroth her in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion, and in faithfulness. Friend, I had to sit down for that one, and I don't even have knees.

cards.question: Along with betrothing His people to Himself in faithfulness, what does the LORD tell them they'll do?

answers.text: Build a house for the LORD

cards.text: Then the LORD says that on that day, He will respond to the heavens. And it doesn't stop there.

cards.question: On that day, the LORD responds to the heavens. Who does He say the heavens will respond to?
The chain of responses keeps going: the earth will respond to the ___, to the new wine and oil.

cards.text: Then the grain, new wine and oil will respond to Jezreel. That's the name the LORD had Hosea give his first son (Hosea 1:3-4).

Then the LORD says He'll sow her as His own in the land. Earlier in this book, the LORD had Hosea name a daughter and a second son born to Gomer, his wife, with names meaning No Compassion and Not My People (Hosea 1:6-9).

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says He will have compassion on "No Compassion."

cards.text: And to those called Not My People, the LORD says He will say, "You are My people."

cards.question: When the LORD tells the ones once called "Not My People" that they are His people, how do they answer Him?
